info.name: NPF Manifest Checker API v1
info.description:
Versioned Manifest Checker API built from the supplied operations-room designs. All responses use the {status, message, data} envelope. Sign in first; the login request saves the bearer token to the collection variable.

Generated requests: 97. Seeded demo officer: NPF-88214 / Password@123 (change in production). Watchlist edit code: 123456.
